title: 鐵路機廠檢修動線
summary: 本課聚焦機廠資源配置檢修節拍與安全動線。從檢修工位利用率建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把車輛工位狀態管理與檢查面照明分布連成可驗證的介面，最後以維修品質抽樣推論整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies depot resources maintenance cycles and safe movement paths. Start with utilization of maintenance bays to define physical or information boundaries, connect vehicle and bay state management with lighting on inspection surfaces as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through sampling inference for maintenance quality. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 檢修工位利用率與車輛移交完整週期
stages.titleEn: Utilization of maintenance bays & Complete vehicle-handoff cycle
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「檢修工位利用率」與「車輛移交完整週期」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Utilization of maintenance bays" and "Complete vehicle-handoff cycle": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 檢修工位利用率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Utilization of maintenance bays: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「檢修工位利用率」如何影響鐵路機廠檢修動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Utilization of maintenance bays” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maintenance-depot workflow planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將車輛到達需求和可用工位分開，檢查平均利用率相同時尖峰排隊仍可能完全不同。利用率比較需求與服務能力，是穩定性檢查而非等待時間的完整答案。平均需求小於平均容量仍可能出現短暫尖峰與排隊；若排程把所有時段填滿，任何變異都只能向後傳播，缺乏讓系統恢復的空間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「檢修工位利用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate vehicle arrival demand from available bays, checking why identical mean utilization can still produce very different peak queues. Utilization compares demand with service capacity; it is a stability check rather than a complete waiting-time answer. Mean demand below mean capacity still permits bursts and queues. When every interval is fully occupied, variability propagates downstream because no recovery space remains. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Utilization of maintenance bays” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「檢修工位利用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Utilization of maintenance bays”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 檢修工位利用率
knowledge.text: 本單元將車輛到達需求和可用工位分開，檢查平均利用率相同時尖峰排隊仍可能完全不同。利用率比較需求與服務能力，是穩定性檢查而非等待時間的完整答案。
knowledge.textEn: Separate vehicle arrival demand from available bays, checking why identical mean utilization can still produce very different peak queues. Utilization compares demand with service capacity; it is a stability check rather than a complete waiting-time answer.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「檢修工位利用率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Utilization of maintenance bays" is correct?
options: 平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊
本單元將車輛到達需求和可用工位分開，檢查平均利用率相同時尖峰排隊仍可能完全不同。
檢查工具停止作業就代表整個機廠工位週期已完成
optionsEn: Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms.
Separate vehicle arrival demand from available bays, checking why identical mean utilization can still produce very different peak queues.
The maintenance-bay cycle is complete as soon as inspection tools stop working.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將車輛到達需求和可用工位分開，檢查平均利用率相同時尖峰排隊仍可能完全不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate vehicle arrival demand from available bays, checking why identical mean utilization can still produce very different peak queues. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 檢修工位利用率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Utilization of maintenance bays: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「檢修工位利用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Utilization of maintenance bays” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。公式 y=arrival/service，代入得 y=0.666667 1。邊界：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h. Formula y=arrival/service gives y=0.666667 1. Boundary: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。公式 y=arrival/service，代入得 y=0.666667 1。邊界：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h. Formula y=arrival/service gives y=0.666667 1. Boundary: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「檢修工位利用率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Utilization of maintenance bays", which statement holds?
options: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。
optionsEn: Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 檢修工位利用率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Utilization of maintenance bays: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「檢修工位利用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Utilization of maintenance bays” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。以「檢修工位利用率」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting. For utilization of maintenance bays, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把平均到達率 arrival 從 8 改成 8.8 jobs/h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.666667 變為 0.733333 1。先說明「檢修工位利用率」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only mean arrival rate arrival from 8 to 8.8 jobs/h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.666667 to 0.733333 1. Explain the causal direction for utilization of maintenance bays, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。以「檢修工位利用率」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting. For utilization of maintenance bays, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把平均到達率 arrival 從 8 改成 8.8 jobs/h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.666667 變為 0.733333 1。先說明「檢修工位利用率」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only mean arrival rate arrival from 8 to 8.8 jobs/h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.666667 to 0.733333 1. Explain the causal direction for utilization of maintenance bays, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「檢修工位利用率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Utilization of maintenance bays"?
options: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 檢修工位利用率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Utilization of maintenance bays: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「檢修工位利用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Utilization of maintenance bays” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。回到「檢修工位利用率」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Trace the input chain for utilization of maintenance bays. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。回到「檢修工位利用率」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Trace the input chain for utilization of maintenance bays. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「檢修工位利用率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Utilization of maintenance bays" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。
檢查工具停止作業就代表整個機廠工位週期已完成
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate.
The maintenance-bay cycle is complete as soon as inspection tools stop working.
quiz.explanation: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 車輛移交完整週期：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Complete vehicle-handoff cycle: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車輛移交完整週期」如何影響鐵路機廠檢修動線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Complete vehicle-handoff cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maintenance-depot workflow planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把接車、檢查、移動與交回的工作分段，將完整節拍直接對應檢修物流並保留驗證交回時間。檢修物流的完整週期從接車確認開始，到驗證交回才結束，不能只計工具接觸車輛的時間。各階段若串行使用同一資源，其持續時間需要相加；平行工位可改變整體吞吐，但共用移車通道、量測儀器或簽核人員仍可能成為瓶頸，需在資源圖上明確表示。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單工位無重疊的串行假想作業，未包含備品等待與返工分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車輛移交完整週期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Break receiving, inspection, movement and return into stages, mapping the complete cycle directly to depot logistics and retaining verified handoff time. The maintenance logistics cycle begins at receiving confirmation and ends at verified handoff rather than counting only tool contact. Durations add when stages serially use one resource. Parallel bays can alter throughput, but shared movement paths, instruments or release personnel may remain bottlenecks that must appear explicitly in the resource graph. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Hypothetical non-overlapping serial work in one bay, excluding spares waiting and rework distributions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Complete vehicle-handoff cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：接車確認 receive=120 s；假想檢查工作 inspect=900 s；工位間移動 move=180 s；驗證交回 handoff=240 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: receiving confirmation receive=120 s; hypothetical inspection inspect=900 s; movement between bays move=180 s; verified handoff handoff=240 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「檢查工具停止作業就代表整個機廠工位週期已完成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The maintenance-bay cycle is complete as soon as inspection tools stop working." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車輛移交完整週期」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Complete vehicle-handoff cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 車輛移交完整週期
knowledge.text: 本單元把接車、檢查、移動與交回的工作分段，將完整節拍直接對應檢修物流並保留驗證交回時間。檢修物流的完整週期從接車確認開始，到驗證交回才結束，不能只計工具接觸車輛的時間。
knowledge.textEn: Break receiving, inspection, movement and return into stages, mapping the complete cycle directly to depot logistics and retaining verified handoff time. The maintenance logistics cycle begins at receiving confirmation and ends at verified handoff rather than counting only tool contact.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：檢查工具停止作業就代表整個機廠工位週期已完成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The maintenance-bay cycle is complete as soon as inspection tools stop working. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「車輛移交完整週期」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Complete vehicle-handoff cycle" is correct?
options: 檢查工具停止作業就代表整個機廠工位週期已完成
平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
本單元把接車、檢查、移動與交回的工作分段，將完整節拍直接對應檢修物流並保留驗證交回時間。
optionsEn: The maintenance-bay cycle is complete as soon as inspection tools stop working.
The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
Break receiving, inspection, movement and return into stages, mapping the complete cycle directly to depot logistics and retaining verified handoff time.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把接車、檢查、移動與交回的工作分段，將完整節拍直接對應檢修物流並保留驗證交回時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Break receiving, inspection, movement and return into stages, mapping the complete cycle directly to depot logistics and retaining verified handoff time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 車輛移交完整週期：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Complete vehicle-handoff cycle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車輛移交完整週期」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Complete vehicle-handoff cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：接車確認 receive=120 s；假想檢查工作 inspect=900 s；工位間移動 move=180 s；驗證交回 handoff=240 s。公式 y=3600/(receive+inspect+move+handoff)，代入得 y=2.5 jobs/h。邊界：單工位無重疊的串行假想作業，未包含備品等待與返工分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: receiving confirmation receive=120 s; hypothetical inspection inspect=900 s; movement between bays move=180 s; verified handoff handoff=240 s. Formula y=3600/(receive+inspect+move+handoff) gives y=2.5 jobs/h. Boundary: Hypothetical non-overlapping serial work in one bay, excluding spares waiting and rework distributions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以工單與獨立事件觀察核對四階段起訖，記錄等待原因和返工次數，避免電子完成時間早於實際移交。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check four stage boundaries using work orders and independent event observation, recording wait causes and reruns so electronic completion cannot precede physical handoff.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：接車確認 receive=120 s；假想檢查工作 inspect=900 s；工位間移動 move=180 s；驗證交回 handoff=240 s。公式 y=3600/(receive+inspect+move+handoff)，代入得 y=2.5 jobs/h。邊界：單工位無重疊的串行假想作業，未包含備品等待與返工分布。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: receiving confirmation receive=120 s; hypothetical inspection inspect=900 s; movement between bays move=180 s; verified handoff handoff=240 s. Formula y=3600/(receive+inspect+move+handoff) gives y=2.5 jobs/h. Boundary: Hypothetical non-overlapping serial work in one bay, excluding spares waiting and rework distributions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「車輛移交完整週期」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Complete vehicle-handoff cycle", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：接車確認 receive=120 s。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: receiving confirmation receive=120 s.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：接車確認 receive=120 s；假想檢查工作 inspect=900 s；工位間移動 move=180 s；驗證交回 handoff=240 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: receiving confirmation receive=120 s; hypothetical inspection inspect=900 s; movement between bays move=180 s; verified handoff handoff=240 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 車輛移交完整週期：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Complete vehicle-handoff cycle: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車輛移交完整週期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Complete vehicle-handoff cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以工單與獨立事件觀察核對四階段起訖，記錄等待原因和返工次數，避免電子完成時間早於實際移交。以「車輛移交完整週期」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check four stage boundaries using work orders and independent event observation, recording wait causes and reruns so electronic completion cannot precede physical handoff. For complete vehicle-handoff cycle, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把假想檢查工作 inspect 從 900 改成 990 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.5 變為 2.35294 jobs/h。先說明「車輛移交完整週期」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only hypothetical inspection inspect from 900 to 990 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2.5 to 2.35294 jobs/h. Explain the causal direction for complete vehicle-handoff cycle, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只統計檢查時間會高估工位吞吐，交回前文件缺失可能讓車輛占位卻被系統標示為已完成。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inspection-only accounting overstates bay throughput; missing release evidence can keep a vehicle occupying a bay after software has labelled the task complete. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以工單與獨立事件觀察核對四階段起訖，記錄等待原因和返工次數，避免電子完成時間早於實際移交。以「車輛移交完整週期」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check four stage boundaries using work orders and independent event observation, recording wait causes and reruns so electronic completion cannot precede physical handoff. For complete vehicle-handoff cycle, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把假想檢查工作 inspect 從 900 改成 990 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.5 變為 2.35294 jobs/h。先說明「車輛移交完整週期」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only hypothetical inspection inspect from 900 to 990 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2.5 to 2.35294 jobs/h. Explain the causal direction for complete vehicle-handoff cycle, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「車輛移交完整週期」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Complete vehicle-handoff cycle"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以工單與獨立事件觀察核對四階段起訖，記錄等待原因和返工次數，避免電子完成時間早於實際移交。
所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Cross-check four stage boundaries using work orders and independent event observation, recording wait causes and reruns so electronic completion cannot precede physical handoff.
All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
quiz.explanation: 以工單與獨立事件觀察核對四階段起訖，記錄等待原因和返工次數，避免電子完成時間早於實際移交。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check four stage boundaries using work orders and independent event observation, recording wait causes and reruns so electronic completion cannot precede physical handoff. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 車輛移交完整週期：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Complete vehicle-handoff cycle: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車輛移交完整週期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Complete vehicle-handoff cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只統計檢查時間會高估工位吞吐，交回前文件缺失可能讓車輛占位卻被系統標示為已完成。回到「車輛移交完整週期」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inspection-only accounting overstates bay throughput; missing release evidence can keep a vehicle occupying a bay after software has labelled the task complete. Trace the input chain for complete vehicle-handoff cycle. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單工位無重疊的串行假想作業，未包含備品等待與返工分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Hypothetical non-overlapping serial work in one bay, excluding spares waiting and rework distributions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「檢查工具停止作業就代表整個機廠工位週期已完成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The maintenance-bay cycle is complete as soon as inspection tools stop working." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只統計檢查時間會高估工位吞吐，交回前文件缺失可能讓車輛占位卻被系統標示為已完成。回到「車輛移交完整週期」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Inspection-only accounting overstates bay throughput; missing release evidence can keep a vehicle occupying a bay after software has labelled the task complete. Trace the input chain for complete vehicle-handoff cycle. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「車輛移交完整週期」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Complete vehicle-handoff cycle" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
只統計檢查時間會高估工位吞吐，交回前文件缺失可能讓車輛占位卻被系統標示為已完成。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
Inspection-only accounting overstates bay throughput; missing release evidence can keep a vehicle occupying a bay after software has labelled the task complete.
quiz.explanation: 只統計檢查時間會高估工位吞吐，交回前文件缺失可能讓車輛占位卻被系統標示為已完成。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspection-only accounting overstates bay throughput; missing release evidence can keep a vehicle occupying a bay after software has labelled the task complete. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
